senses.gloss: Rucika, pl., n. of a class of gods: Mahāsamāj., Waldschmidt, Kl. Skt. Texte 4, 〔187.7〕.
Rucitabhānu, n. of a former Buddha: Mv 〔i.139.5〕.
Ruciradhvaja, n. of a Bodhisattva: Gv 〔2.19〕.
Ruciraprabhāsasaṃbhava, n. of a serpent king: Mvy 〔3435〕.
Rucirabhadrayaśaṣ, n. of a Bodhisattva: Gv 〔442.17〕.
Ruciraśrīgarbha, n. of a Bodhisattva: Dbh 〔2.9〕.
rucirā, n. of the 4th Bodhisattva bhūmi (q.v.) acc. to Mv 〔i.76.15〕.

rucyati, also ruccati (= Pali ruccati, M. ruccai; see Chap. 43), pleases, with gen. of person (Skt. rocate): na cāsya rucyanti kadācid anye SP 〔98.11〕 (vs); yaṃ te rucyati Mv 〔ii.464.10〕; (na …)ruccati Mv 〔ii.485.6〕; yā te strī ruccitā (ppp.) Mv 〔ii.427.16〕.
